eyebrow: Search for Common Ground · Imagine If: Balloons · New York, Aug 2026 · One-voice short
title: Imagine If:
headline: A stranger names why common ground is hard today, then names the way back: understand each other.
story: Kalindi asks a woman in a New York park if it is harder to find common ground today. Susan says yes: it's your algorithms. You only see what you already think.

Then she gives the way out: if we understand each other, we can come to a common ground that everybody wants. She says the client’s name in her own words. Then the balloons go up. Inspiring, not generic. One person, about 30 seconds.
do: Open on frame 1 with Susan speaking and “IT'S YOUR ALGORITHMS.” on screen.
Show Kalindi’s question as text, in her exact words.
Show the sign once, long enough to read.
End on “a common ground that everybody wants”, then the balloons.
Cut from the MXF. Match the look and pacing of the approved Balloon Release montage.
dont: No app logo, no social media company, no politics, no side.
Do not open on her wish line. The montage already uses 0:47.8–0:59.7.
No name super. No place name.
No animation in the middle (Kalindi: “it was inauthentic”).
